Name: Simple Golden Walnut Overhaul
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]Simple Golden Walnut Overhaul[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][b]PC single-player[/b] • Multiplayer and split-screen activities are disabled.[/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Keep earning [b]Golden Walnuts after the original 130[/b], then use the [b]Merchant Ledger[/b] for Island Trader supplies, delivery contracts, material exchanges and treasure hunts.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📖 Merchant Ledger[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Use the normal [b]Action button at the Island Trader[/b] to open the ledger. First find all [b]130 original Golden Walnuts[/b], complete the island’s walnut-funded upgrades and unlock the trader.
Choose an activity from the [b]left-hand index[/b]; its trades, requests or clues appear on the [b]right-hand page[/b]. Your spendable walnut balance and merchant rank remain in the header. [b]Ordinary Trades[/b] opens the trader’s original stock.
[b]Mouse:[/b] click entries or buttons; use the wheel to turn pages. [b]Keyboard:[/b] arrows or W/A/S/D move focus, Tab cycles controls, Enter/Space selects, Page Up/Page Down changes pages and Escape goes back. [b]Controller:[/b] D-pad or left stick moves focus, A selects, B goes back and shoulders turn pages.
Back and page buttons use a compact layout at smaller game UI sizes. The gameplay menu needs at least [b]640 × 480 effective UI pixels[/b].[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54225/54225-1792536694-1441951600.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌰 Renewable Golden Walnuts[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Find all [b]130 original walnuts[/b] to unlock bonus rewards from completed activities. The defaults are [b]5% from artifact spots, 2% from fishing, 2% from ore nodes, 1% from monster kills and 1% from planted-crop harvests[/b]. Each source can be set from [b]0–25%[/b]; zero turns it off.

Fishing, ore, monsters and crops each default to [b]five random walnuts per day[/b]. Artifact spots have no separate cap, and the overall daily random cap defaults to [b]unlimited[/b]. Mainland, Ginger Island and other locations have separate switches. Contracts, exchanges and caches are outside these random-reward caps.

Artifact spots must be outdoors; Treasure Totem spots count. Empty-soil hoeing and seed spots do not. Fishing excludes trash, fish ponds and festivals; crop rewards exclude forage and Junimo harvesting. Ordinary stones and Slime Hutch residents do not count.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🎣 Fishing Treasure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Caught [b]normal and golden fishing treasure chests[/b] can contain [b]one Golden Walnut[/b] after you find the original 130. The chest keeps its normal loot. Collect the walnut to add it to your spendable balance; it needs [b]no backpack space[/b] and does not increase original discoveries.

The default is a [b]10% chance[/b] and [b]five chests with a walnut per day[/b]. Set the chance from [b]0–25%[/b]; zero disables this source. Its separate daily limit can be set from [b]0–100[/b], with zero meaning unlimited.

A reward counts toward the treasure limit and overall daily random limit when the chest opens, even before collection. Location switches also apply. Trash catches, fish ponds and festivals do not qualify. The ordinary fish-catch roll remains separate.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🦜 Island Trader Supplies[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Complete the island’s walnut-funded upgrades and unlock the [b]Island Trader[/b] to open the added menu. [b]Ordinary Trades[/b] opens the trader’s usual stock.

Start with [b]fourteen offers[/b]: coffee, espresso, food, farm and beach totems, coal, hardwood, bone fragments, batteries, cinder shards, dragon teeth and fertilizers. Merchant ranks add [b]four more supply offers[/b], completing the food, farming, fishing, mining and travel categories.

Choose a bundle quantity before buying. Purchases go into your backpack and must fit in full. The menu does not buy items back.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54225/54225-1792536693-195347229.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Daily & Weekly Delivery Contracts[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Accept [b]one daily job and one weekly job[/b], then bring the requested items back to the trader. Daily jobs reward [b]two or three walnuts[/b]; larger weekly jobs reward [b]nine to twelve[/b]. Requests use island crops, fish and mining materials.

Deliveries consume the full requested quantity from your backpack. [b]Any quality is accepted[/b], so check your stacks before confirming. Daily jobs expire the next day and weekly jobs expire next Monday. Unfinished jobs carry no penalty.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⭐ Merchant Ranks & Weekly Specials[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Every completed daily or weekly delivery counts as one contract. Complete [b]five[/b] to become a [b]Trusted Customer[/b], unlocking fishing supplies, Tree Fertilizer and the first premium offers. Complete [b]fifteen[/b] to become an [b]Island Partner[/b], unlocking island totems and the remaining premium stock.

[b]Three premium offers rotate every Monday[/b] from a pool of [b]eight[/b]: Rare Seeds, Starfruit Seeds, Rain Totems, Lightning Rods, Seed Makers, Iridium Bars, Crystalariums and Treasure Totems. Each offer shows its required rank and weekly bundle limit.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]♻️ Material Exchanges[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Each of these deliveries earns [b]one walnut[/b]:
50 Bone Fragments • 25 Cinder Shards • 40 Taro Roots • 10 Pineapples • 10 Coconuts

Each exchange can be used [b]four times per week[/b]. Exchanges consume backpack items and do not increase merchant rank.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🗺️ Weekly Treasure Hunt[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Accept a weekly clue and follow it to a clear spot near a landmark in the [b]Beach, Cindersap Forest, Mountain or Town[/b]. A small walnut marker appears when you are nearby. Stand beside it and press the normal [b]Action[/b] button to search.

Each cache awards [b]six walnuts once[/b]. A new clue becomes available next Monday. If the current maps have no suitable clear spot, the trader explains that a cache could not be placed.[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54225/54225-1792536702-864610783.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙️ Settings & Requirements[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] [b]4.0+[/b] on PC. No Android edition is included.

Use optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or [b]config.json[/b] for settings. For GMCM pages, use an [b]effective UI width of at least 960 pixels[/b]; increase the window size or reduce the game’s UI scale if necessary.

The read-only SMAPI command [b]walnut_status[/b] reports eligibility, the original discovery count, spendable walnuts, bonus history, limits and source settings. Native item names follow the game language.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Installation, Saving & Removal[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Extract [b]SimpleGoldenWalnutOverhaul[/b] into [b]Mods[/b]. Close the game before updating and keep your existing [b]config.json[/b].

Progress is stored with the save. The original discovery total remains the original 130-walnut collection; bonus rewards increase spendable currency. After a recorded bonus award, [b]/recountnuts[/b] can repair original discoveries while retaining the exact pre-command spendable balance.

Collect chest walnuts before removing the mod; the unmodified game cannot credit these bonus pickups after 130.

Turning activities off stops new bonuses and trader features, while recount protection for existing bonus earnings remains active as long as the mod is installed. Bought items are native items. Removing the mod does not deliberately remove extra currency, but running the unmodified [b]/recountnuts after removal can replace it[/b] with the original game’s reconstructed balance.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages & Credits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Simplified Chinese.

Suggested by [b]Harold45[/b]. Code and translations were created with AI assistance. Gallery images use the native game renderer with sample progress.[/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4]Please share reports and suggestions on this mod’s page.

[b]For bugs:[/b] include the mod, game and SMAPI versions, platform, what happened versus what you expected, steps to reproduce and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. Add a screenshot or short video if helpful.

[b]For suggestions:[/b] explain what you would like changed or added and how it would help.[/size][/center]
